<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The quest </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/The_World_Wakes <nowiki>The World Wakes</nowiki>]<nowiki> is required to kill Automatons or get them as a Slayer task </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki>.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="stats"><nowiki>Stats</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> level: 67</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per kill: 624</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal kills per hour</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Generators - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 530+ / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 570+ / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 470+</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Tracers - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 550+ / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/689504724159823906.png?v=1" alt="magic" title="magic" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 610+ / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 480+</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Guardians - </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 600+ / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1096130867279171706.png?v=1" alt="melee" title="melee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 650+</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Optimal </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/797896049548066857.png?v=1" alt="slayer" title="slayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> XP per hour: ~390k </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1148995625896120460.png?v=1" alt="necromancy" title="necromancy" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="desirable-drops"><ins><nowiki>Desirable drops</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Static </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694757179403.png?v=1" alt="staticglove" title="staticglove" kind="icon" /><nowiki>, Tracking </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694765699101.png?v=1" alt="trackingglove" title="trackingglove" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and Pneumatic gloves </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/556588694711304193.png?v=1" alt="pneumaticglove" title="pneumaticglove" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ‎ ‎- 1/1000</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Dropped by Guardians (melee), Generators (mage), and Tracers (ranged) respectively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Required for Slayer log.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Also required for crafting the Enchantments of metaphysics, shadows and heroism respectively.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Cresbot </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107269820133477.png?v=1" alt="automaton" title="automaton" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (pet) - 1/1600</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Pet required for slayer log</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="strategy"><ins><nowiki>Strategy</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For Tracers and Generators the core strategy is the same: back yourself into the corner to minimize the chance of getting spec'd by 2 automatons at the same time and taking rapid, heavy damage.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ For Guardians, who roam the middle of the room, it is best to stand near the doorway.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ The special timer starts counting from the time when the automatons are damaged.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Be careful when using &quot;chaining&quot; abilities ( </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153882861568.png?v=1" alt="gchaincaroming" title="gchaincaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/787904334812807238.png?v=1" alt="grico" title="grico" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137809172335951933.png?v=1" alt="threadsoffate" title="threadsoffate" kind="icon" /><nowiki> ) as they will aggro a large number of enemies at once.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="useful-items-and-unlocks"><ins><nowiki>Useful Items and Unlocks</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Most Wanted Card (Automaton) (obtained from Rush of Blood) can be used if you own any, as they will improves the droprate of both the pet and gloves.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Recommended relics:</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773711921195.png?v=1" alt="conservationofenergy" title="conservationofenergy" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Conservation of Energy</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808774068699286.png?v=1" alt="deathward" title="deathward" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Death Ward</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎⬩ This is the most important to further diminish KO potential.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/697808773917573233.png?v=1" alt="furyofthesmall" title="furyofthesmall" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Fury of the Small</nowiki></strong></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Teleport directly there using a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Mask_of_the_Automatons <nowiki>Mask of the Automatons</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005877227315011664.png?v=1" alt="maskoftheautomatons" title="maskoftheautomatons" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or teleport with a </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Sixth-Age_circuit <nowiki>Sixth-Age circuit</nowiki>]<nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/937093290245894154.png?v=1" alt="sixthagecircuit" title="sixthagecircuit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (option 1 &quot;Guthix shrine&quot;), then teleport to the caves by right-clicking &quot;Teleport&quot; on the Guthixian High Druid.</nowiki></p>

</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="useful-items-and-unlocks_1"><ins><nowiki>Useful Items and Unlocks</nowiki></ins></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Pray </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137941003895046284.png?v=1" alt="sorrow" title="sorrow" kind="icon" /><nowiki> / </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1137940996391452772.png?v=1" alt="ruination" title="ruination" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + the deflect curse relevant to style of Automaton you are fighting </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="deflectmage" title="deflectmage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488447201300.png?v=1" alt="deflectmelee" title="deflectmelee" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="deflectrange" title="deflectrange" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Activate </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Sustain </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1005450651347730533.png?v=1" alt="prayer" title="prayer" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/928221126360969226.png?v=1" alt="powderofpenance" title="powderofpenance" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ensure </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/841419289831800882.png?v=1" alt="elderovl" title="elderovl" kind="icon" /><nowiki> and </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/925794592199147581.png?v=1" alt="aggressionpotion" title="aggressionpotion" kind="icon" /><nowiki> are active at all times</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1027212535121850400.png?v=1" alt="attunedportentofrestorationx" title="attunedportentofrestorationx" kind="icon" /><nowiki> will extend your trip durations and protect you against being killed when dragged towards a cluster of ‎ ‎</nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1004107269820133477.png?v=1" alt="automaton" title="automaton" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Bank when these run out (roughly 10-15 minutes depending on RNG)</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Ideal perks for armour (not required but reduce the risk of heavy damage):</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Absorbative 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/890542428556230666.png?v=1" alt="absorbative4" title="absorbative4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + Crystal Shield 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/921410343606034443.png?v=1" alt="crystalshield4" title="crystalshield4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-detail"><nowiki>‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• Devoted 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087713280033.png?v=1" alt="dev4" title="dev4" kind="icon" /><nowiki> + Enhanced Devoted 4 </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/712073087507628035.png?v=1" alt="enhdev4" title="enhdev4" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>

<div class="pvme-source-mechanic">
<h3 id="revo-bar"><nowiki>Revo Bar</nowiki></h3>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/lUxK9Xs.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Use a </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/703581275453128714.png?v=1" alt="ripperpouch" title="ripperpouch" kind="icon" /><nowiki> stocked with scrolls.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ AFKing with melee can be only be used at Guardians.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Stand as shown below:</nowiki></p>

<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Using protection prayers </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195487926845462.png?v=1" alt="DeflectMage" title="DeflectMage" kind="icon" /><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/544195488317046812.png?v=1" alt="DeflectRange" title="DeflectRange" kind="icon" /><nowiki> with </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/565726489362956308.png?v=1" alt="OnyxBakri" title="OnyxBakri" kind="icon" /><nowiki> allows for healing without </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/615613924506599497.png?v=1" alt="soulsplit" title="soulsplit" kind="icon" /><nowiki> as </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/580168050121113623.png?v=1" alt="range" title="range" kind="icon" /><nowiki> does not have burst damage mitigation like </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/643847130619969562.png?v=1" alt="tmwhelm" title="tmwhelm" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/856635090453135382.png?v=1" alt="animatedead" title="animatedead" kind="icon" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ Your </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/867678153966878740.png?v=1" alt="gricocaroming" title="gricocaroming" kind="icon" /><nowiki> may splash on other automatons as curse drain will only be active on your primary target. You can use </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/648976643687317532.png?v=1" alt="elderovlsalve" title="elderovlsalve" kind="icon" /><nowiki> or </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/513190159018098713.png?v=1" alt="Desolation" title="Desolation" kind="icon" /><nowiki> to mitigate this, although the latter may give you some issues with prayer.</nowiki></p>
